tier_1_exact_persistent_id.description: Exact normalized DOI, arXiv ID, or PMID match.

tier_2_title_and_author_year.description: Normalized title similarity >= 0.90 AND (first author surname match OR year within +/- 1 year).

tier_3_preprint_or_bilingual_variant.description: Preprint vs formal journal/conference edition, or bilingual/translated title pair sharing DOI/arXiv/authors + high lexical/numeric overlap.

tier_4_ambiguous_review_band.description: Title similarity in [0.75, 0.90) without shared persistent ID or with conflicting authors/years.

anti_false_merge_guard.description: Never auto-merge records with same first author and same publication year when normalized title similarity < 0.75 and no shared persistent ID.
